source: round 2: written blind by a fresh subagent told only the kind of task (partly doable by the assistant, at least one step only the user can take); it never saw the style text, the 18.8 prompts, or any reply
prompts: Set up a systemd service for my Node app on my Ubuntu VPS and write the unit file and a deploy script. I'll run the sudo commands myself.
Write a GitHub Actions workflow that builds my iOS app and uploads to TestFlight. I'll have to add the App Store Connect API key to repo secrets myself.
Create a Terraform config for an S3 bucket plus CloudFront distribution. I'll need to run `aws sso login` in the browser first, so tell me when.
ugh, my Raspberry Pi won't connect to wifi on boot. Write a wpa_supplicant config and a script that retries, and tell me what I need to do physically on the Pi.
Generate a Flutter app skeleton with Google Sign-In wired up. I'll need to create the OAuth client in the Google Cloud console myself.
Write an Arduino sketch that reads a DHT22 on pin 4 and posts to MQTT. I'll wire the sensor and plug in the board.
Please set up WireGuard on my home server with a client config for my phone, including a QR code. I'll scan it and run the sudo steps.
Write a Python script that pulls my Stripe invoices into a CSV. I'll paste in the live API key when it's ready.
Build a Dockerfile and docker-compose for a Django app with Postgres and Redis. Docker Desktop needs my password to install, so I'll handle that.
Write a Homebrew formula and release script for my Rust CLI. I'll have to authenticate with `gh auth login` in the browser.
Flash my ESP32 with a firmware that blinks an LED and serves a status page over wifi. I'll hold the BOOT button when needed.
Set up a Kubernetes manifest set for my API with ingress and TLS via cert-manager. I'll point the DNS record at the load balancer at my registrar.
Can you write an Ansible playbook to harden SSH on three servers? I'll supply the vault password when it runs.
Create an Android app that scans NFC tags and logs them to Room. I'll need to tap a physical tag to test it.
Write a script to sign and notarize my macOS app. I'll enter my Apple ID app-specific password and approve the 2FA prompt.
Scaffold a Next.js site with Auth0 login and deploy config for Vercel. I'll sign in to Auth0 and Vercel in the browser to authorize.
Make a cron-based backup script that encrypts my Postgres dumps with gpg and uploads to Backblaze B2. I'll type the gpg passphrase and the B2 key.
I want a pfSense-style firewall rule set translated into nftables for my Debian router. Write the config; I'll apply it with sudo and confirm I didn't lock myself out.
Write a Cloudflare Worker that proxies requests to my origin with caching. I'll run `wrangler login` and approve in the browser.
Set up a data pipeline in Airflow that loads CSVs from S3 into BigQuery. I'll create the service account and download the JSON key.
Write a udev rule and a small C program to talk to my USB serial GPS dongle. I'll plug it in and reload udev with sudo.
Create a Tauri desktop app that stores credentials in the system keychain. The OS will prompt me for my login password, so I'll deal with that.
Please write a script to provision a DigitalOcean droplet with doctl and bootstrap it with Caddy. I have to add my payment method first.
Build a Slack bot in TypeScript that posts daily standup reminders. I'll have to approve the app install in my workspace admin page.
Write a Zephyr RTOS project for an nRF52840 dev kit that advertises over BLE. I'll connect the J-Link and press the reset button.
Write a PowerShell script to join a Windows machine to our domain and map network drives. I'll run it as admin and type the domain credentials.
Set up Let's Encrypt with certbot for my nginx site and write the renewal hook. I'll run it with sudo and add the DNS TXT record by hand.
Write a React Native screen that takes a payment with Apple Pay. I'll need to set up the merchant ID in my Apple Developer account.
Write a Jupyter notebook that fine-tunes a small model on my dataset and pushes it to Hugging Face. I'll paste my HF token when asked.
Configure a Pi-hole plus Unbound setup in docker-compose for my LAN. I'll change the DHCP DNS setting on my router's admin page.
Make a Python tool that sends SMS alerts through Twilio when my server's disk fills up. I'll buy a phone number and enter the auth token.
Write a Go program and Makefile for my Linux kernel module test harness. I'll reboot into the test machine and run insmod with sudo.
